name: Beast 21 ~Ryoujoku no Yakata~
source:
10 years ago the hero suddenly became plagued by strange nightmares. 

He remember something about a strange woman in an old mansion  of his youth days.

Willing to discover the truth, the hero goes with his girlfriend to this mansion in a raining night.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=15823]getchu[/url]]
translation:
10年前，主人公突然开始反复做一些诡异的噩梦。

他隐约记得，年少时曾在一座古老宅邸中遇见过一名神秘女子。

为了找出真相，主人公在一个雨夜带着女友来到那座宅邸。

[译自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=15823]getchu[/url]]
